ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; high-intensity white pixels constitute less than 3% of the total visible fluke area against a dominant low-intensity (black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly homogeneous dark pigmentation; isolated high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the central notch interior, the proximal left-mid lobe, and the distal margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 70-75 degrees and a vertical depth roughly equal to 1/5th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency jaggedness; pixel-amplitude of valleys is most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, reaching depths of 10-15 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of discrete, circular high-contrast white clusters (sub-10 pixel diameter) scattered sparsely across the visible dark surface, primarily in the central and left-mid regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized punctate white scarring; the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer's left) displays a more ragged, irregular pixel boundary compared to the more symmetrical right tip.
